verdict.rationale: Anytype gives strong retention control: data stored locally, offline-first, export/import at any time, local-only mode that disables cloud/backup sync entirely, and self-host options for full data sovereignty (docs-29, docs-30, docs-24, docs-6, docs-20). However, the evidence never documents an explicit account/data deletion or purge mechanism, and community feedback notes that while content is encrypted at rest, search indexes are currently unencrypted (comm-9), a caveat on full data control. Missing for 10: explicit deletion/erasure flow documentation, confirmation that local-only/export fully removes remote copies, and independent verification of the encryption-at-rest claims.
